title: Angus & Julia Stone
description: SummerStage Member Presale: Wednesday, November 11 @ 10AM Capital One Cardholder Presale: Wednesday, November 11 @ 10AM General Onsale: Friday, November 13 @ 10AM Aussie sibling duo Angus & Julia Stone have been crafting folk and indie-pop hits since forming in 2006. They’re known for their dreamy, ethereal charm and chart-topping albums including A Book Like This and Down the Way, the latter of which earned them five ARIA awards. Their latest release, Karaoke Bar, “captures a sense of both the granular and the grand,” (Billboard) with its joyful message and bright sound.

title: Odd Mob
description: Known for his genre-defying approach, Australian producer and DJ Odd Mob has cemented his place at the forefront of global electronic music. He broke through with the 2014 hit ‘Is It A Banger’; since then, Odd Mob has released a string of hits like ‘LEFT TO RIGHT,’ ‘Get Busy,’ and many more, pushing him past 400+ million streams across platforms.
